name: lovedone-mcp
stderr:
LovedOne Family MCP (lovedone-mcp) needs LOVEDONE_API_KEY.
Mint a sk-sand-… key at:
  https://inbox.lovedone.app/settings/mcp-keys

Sign in at https://inbox.lovedone.app → Settings → MCP keys. Copy the plaintext once (sk-sand-…). A Soft / agency key will not work here.
Then set:
  LOVEDONE_API_KEY=sk-sand-…
This CLI only talks to https://api.lovedone.app/mcp/v1.
Docs: https://docs.joinsandwich.com/mcp-family.html
